en: Vintage tinted postcard showing a lively urban street scene. Multi‑story buildings with balconies and enclosed galleries line a sloping square filled with people in early 20th‑century clothing, horse‑drawn carts, and kiosks. On the right side margin, in red script, it reads "Vigo Puerto del Sol" and there is a purple round stamp from a public library. Additional small red vertical text appears along the right edge near the bottom.
